headline: House of Representatives Backs Bank Indonesia, Explains Why Interest Rates Must Rise to 6%
summary: A parliamentary commission chair backed a Bank Indonesia rate rise to 6% to stabilise the rupiah. The central bank governor described the move as pre-emptive.
why: Bank Indonesia sets the country's benchmark policy rate, and its decisions influence the rupiah, government bond yields and capital flows into Indonesian assets.
original_headline: DPR Pasang Badan Bela BI, Ini Alasan Bunga Harus Naik ke 6%
